scripts.check: pnpm gen-types && oxfmt --check && oxlint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm validate && pnpm test
scripts.typecheck: for c in */tsconfig.json; do tsc -p "$c" --noEmit || exit 1; done
scripts.gen-types: for m in */.claude-plugin/plugin.json; do CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIR_WATCH=1 claude -p --plugin-dir "${m%/.claude-plugin/plugin.json}" /exit > /dev/null; done
scripts.validate: claude plugin validate . && for m in */.claude-plugin/plugin.json; do claude plugin validate "${m%/.claude-plugin/plugin.json}" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: for t in */tests; do claude plugin test "${t%/tests}" || exit 1; done
